overview_description.description:
CTM360 is a Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) and external cybersecurity platform built to help organizations identify exposures, detect emerging threats, and disrupt attacks before they cause impact.

Through its Cyber Threat Intelligence Stack, CTM360 brings together External Attack Surface Management (EASM), Digital Risk Protection (DRP), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Surface, Deep & Dark Web Monitoring, Brand Protection & Anti-Phishing, Security Ratings, Third-Party Risk Management, and fully managed takedowns and threat disruption.

CTM360 connects Indicators of Exposure (IoE), Indicators of Warning (IoW), and Indicators of Attack (IoA), giving security teams continuous visibility into their external attack surface and the threats targeting their organizations. Its platforms are designed to deliver relevant, actionable intelligence while reducing noise and manual effort.

In 2026, CTM360 was recognized in the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cyberthreat Intelligence Technologies, becoming the first technology and software company from the Arab world to be included in the report.

Headquartered in Bahrain, CTM360 delivers preemptive cybersecurity technology to organizations globally, helping security teams see threats earlier, reduce external exposure, and become harder targets.

product.name: HackerView
product.description: An external attack surface management platform that discovers internet-facing assets, identifies exposure issues, monitors changes, and provides risk scoring and remediation guidance.

product.name: CyberBlindspot
product.description: A digital risk protection platform that monitors surface, deep, and dark web activity for organization-specific threats, including phishing, impersonation, data leakage, fraudulent apps, and lookalike domains.

product.name: ThreatCover
product.description: A threat intelligence platform that centralizes curated threat feeds, reports, adversary activity, and MITRE ATT&CK mappings for investigation, risk-based hardening, and security-tool integration.

product.name: DMARC360
product.description: An email security and DMARC management platform that analyzes sending sources, supports authentication deployment, monitors impersonation, and provides reporting and configuration assistance.

product.name: RiskHub
product.description: A third-party risk management platform that combines external security monitoring, vendor assessments, supply-chain visibility, compliance mapping, and centralized risk reporting.

product.name: Managed Takedowns & Disruption
product.description: A managed incident response service that coordinates the removal of phishing sites, impersonation accounts, fraudulent applications, malicious domains, and other external threats.
